verdict.rationale: The only residency-related evidence is a documented workaround: customers with data residency or PII jurisdiction requirements can send to synthetic email addresses and forward them through their own email relay, which keeps real addresses out of Customer.io. Nothing in the pack shows a first-class choice of storage region or workspace residency. Missing for 10: an explicit region/data-center selection option (e.g., US vs EU), documentation of where workspace data is stored, residency coverage beyond email addresses, and independent corroboration.
